subject: Appointment
detail: Thyrocare Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Sarovar Chandra as Chief Technology Officer under the category of Senior Management Personnel of the Company w.e.f. November 24, 2026.

subject: Cessation
detail: Thyrocare Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding De-Identification of Mr Piyush Singh, Vice President B2B Operations from the category of Senior Management Personnel of the Company w.e.f. November 24, 2026. He continues in the employment of the Company in his present role.
